title: AI GameStore: Scalable, Open-Ended Evaluation of Machine General Intelligence with Human Games
abstract: arXiv:2602.17594v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rigorously evaluating machine intelligence against the broad spectrum of human general intelligence has become increasingly important and challenging in this era of rapid technological advance. Conventional AI benchmarks typically assess only narrow capabilities in a limited range of human activity. Most are also static, quickly saturating as model capabilities improve. We propose that a more promising way to evaluate human-like general intelligence in AI systems is through a particularly strong form of general game playing: studying how and how well they play and learn to play all conceivable human games, in comparison to human players with the same level of experience, time, or other resources. We define a "human game" to be a game designed by humans for humans, and argue for the evaluative suitability of this space of all such games people can imagine and enjoy -- the "Multiverse of Human Games". translated_title: AI GameStore：基于人类游戏的可扩展、开放式机器通用智能评估
translated_abstract: 在技术快速发展的时代，将机器智能与人类通用智能的广泛范围进行严格评估变得越来越重要且充满挑战。传统的AI基准测试通常只评估人类活动中有限范围内的狭窄能力，而且大多是静态的，随着模型能力的提升很快就会饱和。我们提出，评估AI系统中类人通用智能的一种更有前景的方法是通过一种特别强大的通用博弈形式：研究AI系统如何以及多么擅长玩和学习所有可想象的人类游戏，并与具有相同经验水平、时间或其他资源的人类玩家进行比较。我们将“人类游戏”定义为由人类为人类设计的游戏，并论证了这一由人们可以想象和享受的所有此类游戏构成的空间——“人类游戏多元宇宙”（Multiverse of Human Games）——的评估适用性。作为迈向这一愿景的第一步……
tldr: 提出以“人类游戏多元宇宙”——所有由人类为人类设计的游戏——作为可扩展、开放式的机器通用智能评估框架，通过让AI在相同资源条件下与人类玩家比较玩和学玩所有人类游戏的能力，克服传统基准测试狭窄且易饱和的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes using the "Multiverse of Human Games" — all games designed by humans for humans — as a scalable, open-ended evaluation framework for machine general intelligence, by comparing AI agents to human players with equivalent experience, time, or resources in playing and learning all conceivable human games.
